DEBUG.Title: Debug file
DEBUG.Hint: One file about all of Sephral's modules in this world, for bug reports. It contains chat text and whispers.
DEBUG.Saved: Debug file saved: {file}. It contains chat text and whispers, check it before you share it.

MENU.Title: Translator
MENU.Hint: Translate a Sephral module into your language and see every word at once in the real windows. Every player can open it.

Window.langTitle: ✓ means this module already comes with the language. Missing yours? Pick Other language... and type its code.
Window.pick: Pick a text on the left to translate it.
Window.pickScreen: Pick a text on screen: click this, then click a text in any window of the module
Window.reviewHint: For reviewers: open a submitted translation file and check it in the real windows
Window.importHint: Load a language file, a submission or a review file (or drop it on this window)
Window.exportHint: Save your translation as a language file for Foundry
Window.submitHint: Send your translation to Sephral through Discord or GitHub
Window.samplesHint: Windows of this module filled with made-up data, so every text can be seen in its place. Nothing in them is saved.

Guide.head: How it works:
Guide.pick: Pick a text on the left, or press the crosshair next to the search and click a text in a window of the module.
Guide.type: Type your translation. The module shows it at once, in every window.
Guide.next: Ctrl+Enter takes you to the next text that still needs work. Your draft saves itself.
Guide.submit: Done, or done for today? Submit sends what you have through Discord or GitHub.

Message.pickLanguage: Choose the language you translate into above.
Message.notEnglish: English is the source language. Type the code of the language you translate into.
Message.badLanguage: That is not a language code. Use letters, and add a region like pt-BR if you want.

Detail.markCheck: Mark this text to check it again later
Detail.nothingYet: Nothing typed yet. The window shows the English text.
Detail.notInPreview: The preview skips this text until the error is fixed.
Detail.englishChanged: The English text changed after you translated it.

note.ok: Review by {name}: OK, with a remark

Detail.nextKeys: Ctrl+Enter, Alt+arrow keys for the list

Memory.title: Already translated elsewhere
Memory.same: {count} more texts here have the same English and no translation yet.
Memory.sameOne: 1 more text here has the same English and no translation yet.

Pick.start: Click a text of {module} in any window. Escape stops.
Pick.none: That text is not part of {module}. Pick a text of this module, or choose its module above.
Pick.several: {count} texts have these words. The first one is selected, the others can take the same translation.

Hint.plural: This text contains a count (a number). Word it so it reads right for one and for many, or use a form that works for every number.

State.liveHint: This text is on screen now and changes while you type.
State.mapHint: The module draws this text on the map. It changes there while you type, wherever the map shows it.
State.openHint: Not on screen right now. Open window looks for the window that shows it and outlines the place.
State.settingHint: This text is in Foundry's settings, on the tab of this module. Open settings shows the place.
State.searching: Looking for the window that shows this text...
State.inSettings: The settings of the module are open, the place is outlined.
State.openedHidden: The window is open, but the text is in a part that is not visible right now.
State.reloadHint: Foundry reads this text only at start. You see your version after you reload the page.
State.notShown: This text is not on screen right now.

Where.notify: This text is a notice at the top of the screen. It shows when the situation comes up, then with your text.
Where.chat: This text is part of a chat message of the module. New messages show your text.
Where.dialog: This text is in a question the module asks during an action. It shows when you start that action.
Where.player: This text is in a window only players see. Log in as a player to see it.
Where.window: This text is in a window the module opens only in certain situations, for example after an action.
Where.unknown: No window shows this text on its own. It appears when the module needs it, for example after an action.
Where.gmSetting: This text is in a setting only the gamemaster can see.

Simulate.notifyHint: This text is a notification at the top of the screen. Show an example brings it up with your text, placeholders with sample values.
Simulate.chatHint: This text belongs to a chat message of the module. Show an example puts such a message with your text into your chat, only for you and never saved.
Simulate.dialogHint: This text is in a question the module asks. Show an example opens such a question with your text.
Simulate.shown: The example is shown, only in your browser.
Simulate.failed: The example could not be shown.

Samples.opened: Sample window opened: {name}. The data is made up and nothing in it is saved.
Samples.failed: The sample window could not be opened.
Samples.shown: A sample window with made-up data shows this text, outlined in {count} places.
Samples.shownOne: A sample window with made-up data shows this text, outlined in 1 place.
Samples.chatHint: This text belongs to a chat message. Open window shows it in a sample window of the module, with made-up data.
Samples.labelHint: This text names a sample window of the module. You see it in the field Sample windows at the top.

Needs.notice: {module} needs {needs}, and this world does not have it. Its windows do not open here, so you cannot see the texts in their place or open sample windows. You can still translate every text and hand it in. To see the texts, open the translator in a world that has it.
Needs.hint: This module shows no window in this world (it needs {needs}). Show the code tells you where the text is used.
Needs.elsewhere: Only in another world (open the translator there)

Code.hint: This is where the module uses the text. The marked line holds the key, the lines around it show what it is for.
Code.none: The key is not written out in the code of the module, it is put together from parts.

Submit.title: Submit translation
Submit.intro: Submit your translation on Sephral’s Discord server in {channel} or as an issue on GitHub. Translator sends nothing itself. It saves a file and prepares your message, and you attach the file there. On Discord you can ask questions right away.
Submit.linkGithub: Issues of the module on GitHub
Submit.nothing: There is no finished translation yet.
Submit.errors: {count} texts still have errors. Fix them first.
Submit.errorsOne: 1 text still has errors. Fix it first.
Submit.attest: I translated every text myself by hand, or together with people who did, and I speak the language well enough to stand behind it. No machine translation and no AI was used, not even as a draft.
Submit.license: Sephral may publish and adapt my translation with the modules under the module license. I get no money for it. My name is only shown if I give it, and I can ask to have it removed. Once published, the translation cannot be taken back, and a name in the Git history stays there.
Submit.name: Name for the credits
Submit.creditAnonymous: Keep me anonymous, my name appears nowhere

missingParts.attest: the tick for translated by hand
missingParts.name: the name for the credits

Submit.privacy: The file holds your texts and, if you give it, your name and note. What you post on Discord or GitHub can be seen there by others. To change or withdraw a submission, write in the channel or the issue.

field.line-break: {field} must not contain a line break.
field.url: {field} must not contain a web address.

Submit.unchanged: Nothing changed since your last submission.
Submit.historyHint: Kept only in this browser. To change or withdraw one, write in the Discord channel or the issue.
Submit.copied: The text is copied, paste it with Ctrl+V.
Submit.copyByHand: The browser did not allow copying. The text is selected, copy it with Ctrl+C.

steps.discordHead: Almost done, three steps on Discord:
steps.githubHead: Almost done, two steps on GitHub:
steps.saved: The file was saved as {file} (in your downloads).
steps.discordOpen: Discord is open in a new tab. Join the server if you have not yet. The first time, confirm the rules in #start-here with ✅ and pick your language in #pick-your-languages. Then open {channel}.
steps.discordPost: Drag {file} into the channel and paste the text with Ctrl+V. It is copied already.
steps.githubOpen: The page for a new issue opened in a new tab, the text is filled in already.
steps.githubAttach: Drag {file} into the text box of the issue and click Create.

Submit.rule: Translate by hand only: machine translation and AI tools are not allowed, not even for a draft (Foundry VTT policy on AI generated content).
Submit.openHint: Did no tab open? Use this link:

Use.preview: Only while this window is open
Use.previewHint: Your texts show while the translator is open. When you close it, the module shows its usual texts again.
Use.meHint: Your translation stays in this browser, also after a reload. Only you see it. Texts with errors are left out.
Use.worldHint: Everyone in this world sees your translation in every window opened from now on, and everywhere after a reload. Players who picked a fixed language for this module keep it. Later changes are shared when you close the translator.
Use.worldByGM: The GM shares this translation with everyone in this world. Pick "Always, in my Foundry" to use your own instead.

Review.title: Review a translation
Review.rule: Read and judge by yourself: no machine translation and no AI tools, neither to check nor to rewrite a text.
Review.hint: While this window is open, the submitted texts show in the real windows of the module. Mark every text OK or Needs change and suggest a better wording where needed. OK moves on to the next text that is not reviewed yet.
Review.head: {module} {version} into {lang}, translated by {translator}, {count} texts
Review.pick: Pick a text on the left to review it.
Review.copied: Copied. Paste it in the post of this translation in #review-queue and attach the review file.
Review.copyByHand: The browser did not allow copying. The text is selected below, copy it with Ctrl+C.
Review.saved: The review file was saved as {file} (in your downloads). Attach it to the post in #review-queue.
Review.noModule: This submission is for {module}, which is not active in this world. Enable it and open the file again.
